slides.title: 6 skin myths, on *trial*
slides.sub: Most of us still believe at least two of them.

slides.title: "Oily skin doesn't need moisturizer"
slides.body: Skipping it can leave skin *dehydrated*, and dehydrated skin often looks shinier, not less.
slides.fix: Use a light, oil-free gel moisturizer.

slides.title: "No SPF needed indoors"
slides.body: UVA rays pass through window glass. Desk by a window? *Your skin is outside.*
slides.fix: Wear SPF if you sit near windows or drive a lot.

slides.title: "Hot water opens pores, cold closes them"
slides.body: Pores don't have muscles. Very hot water mostly *dries skin out*.

slides.title: "SPF 50 means fewer reapplies"
slides.body: Every SPF breaks down with sun, sweat and touch. The number doesn't extend the clock.

slides.title: "Expensive means it works better"
slides.body: Price buys packaging and branding too. *Ingredients and fit* decide results.
slides.fix: Judge the formula against your skin, not the price tag.

slides.title: "Drinking water fixes dry skin"
slides.body: Hydration helps your whole body, but dry skin also needs moisture *from the outside*.
slides.fix: Water plus a moisturizer that fits your skin type.

slides.title: The verdicts
items: Water helps, moisturizer finishes the job

slides.title: Which one did *you* believe?
slides.body: Follow for skin, decoded. Glowi turns a quick scan into a routine for your skin.
